Use the rule that the radius is half the diameter: \(r=14/2=7\).

method.method_draft: First describe the image: \(Q\) is the center, \(T\), \(U\), and \(V\) lie on the circle, and segments from \(Q\) to points on the circle are radii. Along the straight vertical segment, \(TU\) is made of \(TQ+QU\). Since \(TQ\), \(QU\), and \(QV\) are all radii of the same circle, \(TQ=QU=QV=r\). From the text, \(TU=14\), so \(14=r+r=2r\), giving \(r=7\).
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是以 Q 为圆心的圆，Q 用一个点标出。T 在圆的上方圆周上，U 在圆的下方圆周上，竖直线段 TU 穿过圆心 Q。V 在右侧圆周上，并且有线段 QV 从圆心连到 V。推理：因为 Q 是圆心，T、U、V 都在圆周上，所以 TQ、QU、QV 都是同一个圆的半径，设半径为 r。竖直线段 TU 由 TQ 和 QU 组成，因此 TU = TQ + QU = r + r = 2r。已知 TU = 14，所以 2r = 14，解得 r = 7。
